status: preregistered before execution; candidate, not reviewed or accepted

system.family: temporal knowledge graph memory (LLM extraction, entity/fact edges with validity intervals)
system.graph_store: embedded FalkorDB Lite (falkordblite==0.10.0; bundled redis-server sha256 0bc4c257f748..., falkordb.so sha256 fc0297205c62...)

llm.client: OpenAIGenericClient, structured_output_mode=json_schema (Graphiti default), schema-constrained decoding via shim
llm.temperature_deviation: Graphiti default 1.0; 0 declared here before any benchmark execution, for reproducibility

embedder.note: the embedding model of Graphiti's own local example (nomic-embed-text); no task prefixes, as in that example

system.cross_encoder: OpenAIRerankerClient on the same local LLM config; unused by the default search recipe
system.capability_tier: LLM at ingestion (local 3B model); retrieval without LLM

adapter.add: add_episode per AMB document: name=uuid5(doc id), body=document.content verbatim, source=text, source_description='user memory', reference_time=document.timestamp, group_id=user
adapter.search: Graphiti.search(query, group_ids=[user], num_results=k), k = AMB per-case retrieval_limit (maxBeliefs, default 20)
adapter.identity_mapping: edge.episodes -> episode uuid -> AMB document id; one AMB Document per supporting episode in Graphiti order (source_ids=[doc id]); list cut to k; unmapped edges passed through to AMB's resolver and counted

protocol.runner: reference/run_amb_external.py (git blob 3666114e7430) = 1df28f8 plus registration of graphiti-local
protocol.filters: none (protocol A: supports_filters=False, the same as agent-memory 15/77 and bm25 8/77)
protocol.command: python scripts/run_amb_local_evidence.py --amb-root /tmp/agent-memory-benchmark --python /tmp/am-bench/graphiti-amb-venv/bin/python --evidence-dir <dir> --set-env TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/am-bench/tiktoken-cache --set-env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 --set-env GRAPHITI_LOCAL_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8089/v1 -- run --dataset precisionmembench --split single-turn --memory graphiti-local --mode retrieval

runs.primary: rep 1, the first complete 77-case run; it is the reported result
runs.repeat: rep 2, a full fresh rerun (new graph, same models and settings), if host time allows; reported as repeatability evidence, never substituted for rep 1

outcomes: AMB correct/77 with active/structural/trivially-empty passes, mean precision, mean recall, per-category passes (AMB native)
per-case paired comparison with agent-memory rep 1 and bm25 from the reviewed 1df28f8 evidence (scripts/compare_amb_runs.py), exact McNemar on discordant cases
ingestion: per-episode seconds, nodes, edges, invalidated edges; LLM and embedding call counts, prompt/completion tokens and wall seconds from the shim log
retrieval latency (AMB retrieve_time_ms), wall time, peak RSS
failure_rules: a provider or harness exception fails the run; a failed run is reported as failed with its logs and is not scored
no retry of individual cases or episodes beyond Graphiti's own internal retries
no change to models, prompts, settings or mapping after this registration; any change is a new, separately registered generation
comparability: Same harness, inputs, budgets, scorer and protocol A as agent-memory 15/77, but a different capability tier: Graphiti uses an LLM at ingestion (a local 3B model here), Agent Memory and BM25 use none. Reported as a separate profile row; not ranked as same-tier. Not representative of Graphiti with a frontier LLM, and not Zep's hosted product.
